name: Ancient History
visual_identity: Ancient settings: handmade tools, clay, bronze, linen and carved stone; warm daylight, firelight or soft dawn light; ruins, workshops and wide landscapes; calm and contemplative, no anachronisms.

environment.setting: A peaceful hut in a valley in the Alps
environment.background_theme: A quiet Alpine valley, soft morning light, distant mountains, and a welcoming rustic hut.
environmental_conventions: Maintain a peaceful and coherent environment.
Keep backgrounds appropriate to the current story.
Use the Alpine hut as the prototype narration setting rather than forcing it into every historical reconstruction.

storytelling_conventions: Allow reflective moments without slowing the story unnecessarily.

image_generation_guidance.background_theme: peaceful Alpine hut and valley during a serene morning
